findings.evidence: "assert that every src/logger.ts occurrence lies inside the derivation and the section render rather than a branch"
findings.expected: B-11's observable result should carry the same carve-out its contract half states — "no occurrence sits inside an `if`, ternary, comparison or `GateDeclaration` literal outside the summary render" — because B-10 requires the render to print `Changed rate: n/a` when `graded` is `0`, which is necessarily a branch on a value B-09 derives.
findings.observed: The manifest drops the "outside the summary render" qualifier and reads as though no occurrence may sit inside a branch at all, which the B-10 `n/a` line cannot satisfy. The contract's B-11 text is the operative, correctly scoped statement; the manifest's paraphrase is looser than the obligation it restates.
findings.clearCondition: B-11's observableResult restates the carve-out explicitly, so that a conditional on `changedRatePercent`/`graded` inside the `## Self-Audit` render is stated as permitted and only gate, threshold, merge and dispatch branches are forbidden.

findings.evidence: "absent, negative, fractional, NaN, Infinity or a non-number all dispatch exactly once and land AUDIT_NOT_RUN"
findings.expected: Each degenerate budget the Then asserts should appear in the Given, or the Then should claim only what the Given drives.
findings.observed: The Given lists four case (c) inputs (omitted, `-1`, `1.5`, `Number.NaN`) and the observableResult counts "each of the four case (c) inputs", but the Then also asserts `Infinity` and a non-number read as `0`. `Infinity` is a reachable value that no declared input covers; a non-number is additionally unreachable through a typed `SelfAuditStageInput` literal, so `typecheck` and `tests` together produce no evidence for it.
findings.clearCondition: Case (c)'s Given adds an `Infinity` input (making five counted inputs), and the non-number clause is either dropped from the Then or restated as a defensive runtime coercion with no declared test evidence.

findings.evidence: "src/logger.test.ts's [behavior:B-12] text test reads the ADR, whitespace-normalizes it"
findings.expected: An ADR text assertion about the self-audit stage's one-invocation bound belongs at a seam that owns that subject — `src/self-audit.test.ts` or `src/orchestrator.test.ts`.
findings.observed: It is placed in `src/logger.test.ts`, which owns run-summary rendering and event derivation. The file is in scope so the gate still produces evidence, but the assertion's home does not match its subject and the next reader of ADR 0069 will not find it.
findings.clearCondition: B-12's observableResult names `src/self-audit.test.ts` (or `src/orchestrator.test.ts`) as the home of the ADR text test.

findings.evidence: "- src/self-audit.ts" … "- CONTEXT.md" (fifteen paths) with thirteen in-scope behaviors and six preservation behaviors
findings.expected: A single generator session should carry the whole scope with slack for the heavy-suite runs the Definition of done names (`test:heavy:orchestrator`, `test:heavy:qa`).
findings.observed: The slice is at the top of one session: a classifier, a bounded retry loop, a run-state schema bump with three stale literal pins in two heavy suites, a new run event, a new derivation, a summary section, an ADR amendment and a CONTEXT.md term. Each piece is small and mirrors a cited existing pattern, and the risky piece — the unconditional `RUN_STATE_VERSION` 7 → 8 bump — has its full blast radius enumerated (`src/eval-boundary.test.ts:127`, `src/qa-orchestration.test.ts:1028`, `src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts:1043`), which is what makes it feasible rather than speculative. Flagged only so the session sequences the bump and its pins first.
findings.clearCondition: No contract change required; if the session runs long, the reporting half (B-08 through B-11) is the separable remainder.
